outcome: Preterm birth (PTB) < 24, 28, 32 and 34 weeks of gestation
Interval time between cerclage placement (or indication for cerclage) and delivery
cohort: Women with asymptomatic twin pregnancies and cervical shortening or dilation
finding: Cervical cerclage in asymptomatic twin pregnancies with cervical shortening or dilation was associated with a longer gestational age at delivery, a longer interval between cerclage placement (or indication for cerclage) and delivery, and a lower risk of preterm birth, cesarean section, stillbirth, and NICU admission.
